अंडमान तथा निकोबार प्रशासन
ANDAMAN AND NICOBAR ADMINISTRATION
सचिवालय / SECRETARIAT
****
Sri Vijaya Puram, dated the 14th August, 2026.

To
 All Heads of Department /Office (As per list enclosed)
 · A&N Administration.

Sub- Circulation of Final Seniority List of Office Superintendent of AC Cadre
as on 01.07.2026 – reg.

I am directed to refer to this Administration's letter of even number
dated 03.07.2026 vide which the Provisional Seniority List of Office
Superintendent of AC Cadre as on 01.07.2026 was forwarded for circulation
amongst the OS working under your control and to forward claims &
objections, if any, received from them. No claims & objections have been
received from any of the officials concerned and accordingly, the Final
Seniority List has been prepared.

A copy of the Final Seniority List of Office Superintendent as on
01.07.2026 is accordingly forwarded herewith with the request that the same
may be circulated amongst the officials working under your control.

Yours faithfully,
Digitally signed by
K. Ajit Kumar
Date: 14-08-2026
18:28:28
(K. Ajit Kumar)
Deputy Secretary (Personnel)

Copy to:-

1. All Sections in the Secretariat, A&N Administration alongwith a copy of
above Final Seniority List for information.
2. The Assistant Manager (IT), Secretariat with the request to upload the
Final Seniority List in the department's website.
